description: Read-only structured Anki totals for the whole collection or one deck including its subdecks. Returns card and linked-note counts, recorded answers and time across available history, and current card categories. For today's workload use get-deck-stats. Requires AnkiConnect v1.

deckId.description: Deck ID from list-decks. Includes child decks. Omit for the whole collection.

name: get-study-summary

cardCount.description: All existing cards in the selected scope.

newCount.description: Active new cards, not the daily new-card allowance.

noteCount.description: Distinct notes linked to those cards. Notes without a matching card are not counted.

reviewCardCount.description: Active review cards, whether due now or not.

reviewCount.description: Recorded card answers across available history, not the number of cards due today.

reviewTimeMs.description: Total time attributed to those answers, in milliseconds as reported by Anki.

suspendedCount.description: Suspended cards. Buried cards are not reported as a separate category.

title: Get study summary
